title: messages/messages.config.yml — rasa.module.messages (records-family/1)
description: What a project declares to rasa.module.messages. Every key except `schema` is optional and a project with no config file is valid, except that writing as yourself (draft, reply, mark-sent, log --sent of a kind you compose) refuses until an identity is declared for the channel. Every list follows declare-to-constrain: absent or [] = free; non-empty = closed.

channels.description: Declare to constrain: the channels this project keeps (email, text, chat, voice, post). Empty: all five.

services.description: Declare to constrain: the chat services (slack, whatsapp, signal, teams, ...).

address.description: The literal address you write from on that channel.

card.description: Your own contact card, when rasa.module.crm keeps one.

identities.description: THE HARD-STOP: who you may write as, per channel. `messages draft`, `reply`, `mark-sent` and `log --sent` for a kind you can compose refuse until the channel has one.

stale_after.description: Days after which a sent message with no answer shows as waiting. Default 7.

timezone.description: The zone a wall-clock time given to the tool is read in ('2026-09-28 14:00'). Optional: times with an offset and 'now' need none.
